item.title: U.S. Senate Democratic candidates to face off in statewide debate
item.description: WGN News will host a debate on February 19 between the leading candidates for the Democratic Party nomination for U.S. Senator from Illinois, moderated by WGN News political editor Tahman Bradley and anchor/reporter Micah Materre.

item.title: No longer legal to throw old batteries in the trash, according to new state law
item.description: Peoria's City Hall is reminding residents that a new state law prohibits the disposal of batteries in trash or curbside recycling, and instead encourages them to use the Battery Network's approved recycling program.

item.title: Peoria blaze: Open burning causes $50K damage to garage, carport
item.description: Open burning on Tuesday morning led to a fire that caused $50,000 in damage to a detached garage and carport in Central Peoria.

item.title: Bloomington police looking for armed robbery suspect
item.description: A man allegedly brandished a gun and demanded money from a cashier at a business near South Main and West Wood Streets before fleeing on foot.

item.title: Black maternal health is still a major unsolved issue
item.description: Black women are three times more likely to die from pregnancy complications than any other race, and a new bill, the Wells Act, is being proposed to require hospitals to provide written reasons for discharging pregnant patients and to provide racial bias training for all healthcare staff.

item.title: UPDATE: Peoria police chief says he's 'frankly exhausted' by ongoing cycle of violence
item.description: Four students were arrested after allegedly stealing a Jeep and driving around Peoria, doing donuts in school parking lots, throwing things out the window, targeting police officers, and attacking a student before crashing the vehicle.

item.title: Illinois ranks 8th in nation for energy cost concerns
item.description: Illinois ranks eighth in the nation for energy cost searches, with 54 out of 100,000 online searches related to energy awareness, 140 related to financial strain, and 49 related to emotional anxiety.

item.title: Firefighters rescue person trapped after Peoria rollover crash
item.description: The Peoria Fire Department rescued a person who was trapped in a vehicle after a rollover crash on Tuesday, causing an estimated $25,000 in damages.

item.title: Local lawmakers hope no broad-based tax increases in Governor's budget
item.description: State lawmakers are preparing for Gov. JB Pritzker's eighth state of the state and budget address, with teachers unions asking for $3 billion in additional funding and a potential $2 billion shortfall, while tax increases could be on the menu to balance the budget.

item.description: Peoria, Ill.
